subject: blank page when using ggvis layer_rects to draw heatmaps

messages.author: 90da98603e64b703
messages.subject: blank page when using ggvis layer_rects to draw heatmaps
parts:
hi all,

I have an issue with drawing a heatmap with ggvis using layer_rects.
For some reason I only get a blank page. I tried to recook the example from http://ggvis.rstudio.com/layers.html.
Here's my minimal example:

library(ggvis)
library(dplyr)

## layer_points works...
expand.grid(a = 1:10, b = 1:10) %>% 
   mutate(c = a*b) %>%
   ggvis(~a, ~b, fill = ~c) %>%
   layer_points()

## ...whereas layer_rects doesn't
expand.grid(a = 1:10, b = 1:10) %>% 
   mutate(c = a*b) %>%
   ggvis(~a, ~b, fill = ~c) %>%
   layer_rects(width = band(), height = band())


here's a correspoding markdown to view the two plots in browser:

http://rpubs.com/agnoscom/layer_rects_issue

thanks for helping out.

florian

messages.author: 912329a6ad1a6995
messages.subject: Re: blank page when using ggvis layer_rects to draw heatmaps
parts:
Hi Florian,

I think the issue is that band() is used to indicate the height or width allocated for a categorical variable. In your case, you might set the width and height explicitly, or use the x2 and y2 arguments, i.e.:

layer_rects(width = 1, height = 1).

Hope this helps,

Ian
